title: Trust and Safety: Goodwill for Late Recovery Review Decisions
content:
# Goodwill for late recovery review decisions

> Harborline Customer Accounts

Harborline's published goodwill schedule for late recovery review decisions credits goodwill to the account, without the customer having to ask, for the account's most recently decided approved recovery request when Trust and Safety decided it later than the schedule allows after it was submitted. A request decided in time, and a rejected or withdrawn request, is outside this schedule.

**Conditions.** Goodwill credit may be granted only while the account status is active, and one grant may be made per affected holding or charge reference. The grant is posted against the recovery request's reference number, with no product category. Where the amount the schedule yields is zero, nothing is owed and no entry is posted.

## Invocation

The goodwill is recorded with the agent-side tool `grant_recovery_delay_goodwill_1cc515a4`. Unlock it first and then call it; it is run by the agent, not handed to the customer. One call records one goodwill credit on the customer's Harborline account credit, posted against the recovery request's reference number with no product category: the account credit balance goes up by the goodwill amount and the goodwill appears on the account's credit history at once, spendable on any Harborline product and never withdrawable.

## Inputs

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | The reference number of the customer's Harborline account, as shown on the account record opened for this customer. | Identifier, as shown on the record |
| `source_charge_ref` | The reference number of the recovery request, character for character, as shown on the account's recovery request record. | Reference exactly as shown on the record; the empty string is not used |
| `amount` | The goodwill credited, in US dollars. | A positive figure with 2 decimal places; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent |

## Receipt and errors

A completed call returns a confirmation line beginning "Goodwill credited", stating the reference number of the new goodwill entry, the amount credited in US dollars with two decimals, the reference it was posted against and the account's new credit balance in US dollars with two decimals.

The call is refused with an error line when `amount` is not a positive US dollar figure, or when `source_charge_ref` is not the recovery request reference unchanged (empty, padded with spaces or containing a space).
